title: Manager - Business Analysis
description:
**Job Title \- Manager – Business Analysis \- ACS Song**

**Management Level: Level 7, Manager**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must have skills: Techno\-functional BA lead with eCommerce experience, CPQ or Pricing; independent client\-facing consulting; consultative selling; and team leadership**

**Good to have skills: Experience across multiple commerce, CPQ or pricing platforms,s pre\-sales, estimation and solution\-shaping exposure**

**Experience: 10\-15 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification**: **Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Commerce or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional certification is preferred**

**Job Summary**


You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled eCommerce, CPQ and pricing solutions. The role requires a consultative techno\-functional Business Analyst Manager who can independently lead client\-facing engagements, shape solutions and proposals, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and lead Business Analyst teams through clear requirements, delivery governance, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead the Business Analysis workstream across eCommerce, CPQ or Pricing delivery, with accountability for the BA strategy, team mobilization, requirements governance, quality standards and stakeholder alignment.
* Partner with client Product Owners, senior business sponsors, solution architects, sales and delivery leaders to shape scope, roadmap, commercial propositions and prioritization decisions.
* Lead executive and senior stakeholder workshops to frame business problems, define measurable outcomes, identify value levers and align on transformation and implementation approaches.
* Guide as\-is/to\-be process design, capability mapping, gap analysis, backlog strategy and release scoping across multiple functional areas.
* Direct, build and quality\-assure epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, functional specifications and decision records produced by the BA team.
* Identify solution options and make recommendations that balance business value, user experience, platform constraints, delivery risk and technical complexity.
* Own requirements traceability, change impact analysis and decision management across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release.
* Lead cross\-functional governance and delivery forums involving client business users, product owners, sales, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, data/integration and programme management.
* Own resolution and executive escalation of complex functional, delivery and scope issues, driving timely decisions and clear accountability.
* Lead estimation, staffing, transition planning, pre\-sales/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, reusable assets and practice/capability development as required.
* Operate as the Business Analysis Manager who independently represents the BA function to client executives, account leadership and delivery leadership.
* Own complex and ambiguous eCommerce problems, mobilize the right stakeholders and drive structured recommendations.
* Lead, coach and performance\-enable a team of Business Analysts; allocate work, review outputs, build capability and ensure consistency, quality and delivery readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders through consultative selling, value\-led storytelling, negotiation and clear recommendation of decision options.
* Contribute to account growth and delivery health by identifying opportunities, risks, dependencies, capability gaps and continuous improvement actions.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility, fulfilment and order status.
* Build trusted client relationships, identify follow\-on opportunities and collaborate with sales and solution teams to progress qualified opportunities.
* Be accountable for BA workstream plans, estimates, staffing needs, milestones, risks, dependencies and the quality of functional deliverables.
* Establish reusable methods, templates and quality gates, and contribute to hiring, mentoring and capability development for the Business Analysis practice.
* Strong techno\-functional understanding of APIs, webhooks, events, integrations, data flows, security, analytics and non\-functional requirements relevant to commerce, CPQ and pricing platforms.
* Ability to lead multiple capability areas across commerce journeys, product configuration, guided selling, quotation, approvals, pricing, promotions, order management, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs, lead fit\-gap analysis and guide business trade\-off decisions with client, architecture and delivery leaders.
* Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Business analysis leadership and requirements governance for complex digital commerce, CPQ or pricing programmes.
* Ability to lead multiple commerce capability areas across discovery, cart/checkout, order management, customer account, promotions, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess commerce platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs and guide business trade\-off decisions with architects and delivery leads.


Executive workshop facilitation, consultative selling, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, negotiation and requirements elicitation.


  

**Professional and Technical Skill**

* 10\-15 years of relevant experience, including leadership of complex client\-facing digital commerce, CPQ or pricing engagements
* Business analysis and requirements analysis for digital products or commerce platforms.
* User story writing, acceptance criteria definition and backlog refinement.
* Jira and Confluence proficiency; ability to maintain product backlog, decisions, traceability and release documentation.
* Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviews, process mapping and requirements elicitation.
* Ability to lead product owners, Business Analysts, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, release and client business stakeholders across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive\-level verbal and written communication for proposals, client presentations, solution pitches, demos, decisions and programme reporting.
* eCommerce domain knowledge across browse, search, PDP, cart, checkout, payments, promotions, order capture and order status.
* Techno\-functional understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics tagging, non\-functional requirements and platform constraints.
* Strong working knowledge of CPQ capabilities including product and bundle configuration, guided selling, quote creation, pricing, approvals, contracts and quote\-to\-cash touchpoints.
* Strong working knowledge of pricing capabilities including price strategy, segmentation, price books/lists, discounts, promotions, taxation, regional pricing, optimisation and price\-engine integrations.
* Experience with one or more relevant platforms such as SAP Commerce/Hybris, commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud/Revenue Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento, Shopify, PROS, Conga or similar is considered a plus.
* Understanding of SDLC phases including development, testing, deployment, maintenance and release governance.
* Relevant certification such as PSPO, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master, commerce platform, CPQ or pricing certification is preferred.
* Pricing domain knowledge including price books, price lists, promotions, discounts, taxation, regional pricing and price engine integrations.
* Working knowledge of delivery automation, version control, deployment strategies and DevOps collaboration sufficient to govern cross\-functional delivery.
* Search, merchandising, CMS, CDP, web analytics, payments, OMS or customer service platform exposure.
* PSPO I, PSPO II, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master or relevant commerce platform certifications.
* Exposure to headless commerce, composable commerce, microservices, event\-driven integrations or cloud\-native delivery.
* Experience with automation pipelines, version control, deployment strategies or DevOps collaboration.

-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744156
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Job Description**



I\&O Platform Infrastructure Application Performance Management and Logging (ELK) SME



Assistant Director \| Enterprise Technology

  


**The opportunity**



In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for a proven Application Performance Management (APM) and Logging SME to support and evolve EY's monitoring and observability platforms globally. The role will provide engineering leadership, operational support, automation and lifecycle management for the firm's APM tooling and the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack. The successful candidate will work with cutting\-edge observability technologies, driving platform maturity, operational excellence and engineering innovation across EY's global infrastructure estate.

  


**Your key responsibilities**



The I\&O Platform Infrastructure APM and Logging SME provides technical leadership and engineering of complex nature for the firm's application performance monitoring and centralized logging platforms. This professional applies knowledge of APM solutions, the ELK stack, log management, metrics pipelines and distributed tracing to support enterprise\-scale workloads and enable rapid incident response.

  



The role requires deep knowledge of the firm's infrastructure monitoring landscape to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, onboarding programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The SME will serve as the subject matter authority for APM and logging platforms, partnering with application teams, infrastructure engineers and security stakeholders across global locations to ensure observability coverage, data quality and platform reliability.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Strong experience designing, deploying and administering ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) at enterprise scale.
* Deep knowledge of APM tooling (e.g., Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM, New Relic or equivalent).
* Experience architecting centralized logging solutions and log aggregation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of metrics, traces and logs as the three pillars of observability.
* Experience with Elasticsearch cluster management, index lifecycle management (ILM) and snapshot/restore.
* Knowledge of Logstash pipeline development and Beats (Filebeat, Metricbeat, Winlogbeat) deployment.
* Experience building Kibana dashboards, visualizations and alerting rules.
* Experience with log parsing, field extraction, grok patterns and data enrichment.
* Knowledge of distributed tracing frameworks and instrumentation approaches.
* Strong scripting and automation skills, including:
	+ Python
	+ PowerShell
	+ Bash / Shell scripting
* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation, runbooks and operational procedures.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams across multiple time zones.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**


* ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) — enterprise\-scale deployment and administration. 7\+ years.
* APM platform engineering and administration (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM or equivalent). 7\+ years.
* Centralized logging architecture design and operations. 7\+ years.
* Elasticsearch cluster management, performance tuning and capacity planning. 7\+ years.
* Logstash pipeline development and Beats agent fleet management. 5–7 years.
* Kibana dashboard and visualization development. 5–7 years.
* Index lifecycle management (ILM), hot\-warm\-cold architecture and data tiering. 5–7 years.
* Log parsing, grok pattern development and field enrichment. 5–7 years.
* Metrics collection frameworks (Prometheus, InfluxDB, StatsD or equivalent).
* Distributed tracing — implementation, instrumentation and analysis.
* Alert management and notification workflows across monitoring platforms.
* SIEM integration and security event log forwarding.
* TLS/SSL configuration and security hardening of ELK components.
* Role\-based access control (RBAC) within Elasticsearch and Kibana.
* Containerized deployment of ELK components (Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift).
* CI/CD pipeline integration for monitoring\-as\-code and configuration management.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for monitoring platforms.
* Performance troubleshooting of high\-ingestion Elasticsearch clusters (50 GB\+/day).
* Onboarding application and infrastructure teams onto APM and logging platforms.
* Windows and Linux systems administration supporting ELK infrastructure.

  


**Ideally, you'll also have**


* Elastic Certified Engineer or Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
* Dynatrace Associate or Professional certification (desired).
* Microsoft Azure Administrator or equivalent cloud certification (desired).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards and collector configuration.
* Experience with Elastic Cloud or Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK).
* Familiarity with cloud\-native logging solutions (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Cloud Logging).
* Experience operating in a managed service or large enterprise shared services environment.

  


**What we look for**



An experienced and technically deep observability engineer and leader to help build, operate and modernize EY's APM and centralized logging platforms. We are looking for an individual with proven expertise in ELK stack engineering, strong APM platform knowledge, a passion for operational excellence and automation, and the ability to serve as the technical authority for monitoring and observability across EY's global infrastructure estate.

  


**What we offer**



We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:


* **Continuous learning**: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you**: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture**: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

  


* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Role\-Based Permissions (RBP) across EC, ONB, RCM, LMS, PMGM and SAP Workzone etc.
* Expertise in Employee Central (EC) security, including permission roles, permission groups, target/granted populations, workflow permission group and role assignments.

* Strong skills in RBP troubleshooting and post\-release access issue resolution.
* Expertise in application security S4H, Fiori, HANA, SAP BTP with deep understanding of authentication, user provisioning, role design management.
* Proficiency in SAP GRC, SoD analysis, risk remediation, and audit frameworks (SOX, GDPR).
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change.
* Business Analysis experience.

* Excellent communication, verbal, presentation and written skills.
* Flexible and reliable\- displaying great ownership in all aspects.

* 6\+ years of application services and/or client/supplier relationship management in a technology environment.

**Job Description**


**Job Title:** SuccessFactors Employee Central Consultant


**Reports to (Job Title):** Application Engineer Team Lead  



**Job Summary:**



(Briefly describe the main objectives and purpose of the job. Why does the job exist? What is it expected to accomplish?)



Talent IT Service Delivery team is responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of programs/projects to develop and maintain global applications and systems in Talent IT Landscape in SAP technology stack.



The main function of this pillar is to coordinates and manages a team of config resources in SuccessFactors modules and will also have full responsibility for the delivery of projects end\-to\-end working with Project Manager, QA resources and Support Team.

  


**Essential Functions of the Job:**



(Describe essential functions, or primary duties and responsibilities. Assume the reader does not know the role or function of the job.)


* Leadership: Ability to inspire, guide, and mentor consultants throughout complex project lifecycles.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Employee Central projects, overseeing all phases from discovery through deployment and support.
* Manage and mentor a team of consultants, assigning tasks and providing guidance throughout project lifecycles.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and resource allocations to ensure deliverables are met on schedule and within budget
* Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to understand business requirements, HR processes, and reporting needs.
* Analyze and document client requirements, translating them into system specifications and design documents.
* Advise clients on best practices, change management strategies, and system adoption approaches.
* Design comprehensive Employee Central solutions, leveraging deep knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors capabilities.
* Configure Employee Central modules, including organizational management, employee data, workflows, business rules, and security settings

  


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Leader and team player – sets example for project managers, business analysts and others to follow
* Create an open, honest, accountable and collaborative team environment

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**



(Describe the knowledge or skills needed to perform this job; these may be technical, managerial or behavioral in nature.)


* In\-depth technical expertise in SAP Employee Central and ONB 2\.0, covering configuration, design, and data replication processes.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and best practices
* Experience with SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP) implementation in highly unionized environments, demonstrating an understanding of unique payroll challenges and requirements.
* Experience of SuccessFactors Employee Central integration with SF Employee Central Payroll (SF ECP), including data management and replication
* Initiates, builds and maintains productive customer relationships
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
